items.description: Accept a practical answer without legal theses instead of regenerating it twice and abstaining
Log a failed payload check in call_tool_deepseek instead of crashing the regeneration turn
End a transient provider error in the abstain instead of failing the whole request
Guard the golden-case calls in the harness the way score() guards its rows
Report an unclosed amendment quote as a warning, so one old edition does not fail the daily parse
Drop the per-request pause in fetch_texts: the daily byte budget already meters Rada
Simplify _last_signal to the latest row of the source
Let MARKER_RE match nested amendment markers
Flag only shrinking ledger entries: a reparse that adds units to an edition is legitimate
Share one JSONL writer and run-id stamp across the harness run and noise outputs
Build channel hit rows and the candidate column list in one place
Report a reference without a tagged pair as a broken reranker pin
Type the injectable generate and pin-check seams of the API
Cache word lemmas so repeated forms are parsed once
Split statements joined by semicolons in the structure parser (lint E702)
Fix lint findings in the freshness probe, the edition diff and the fusion step
Add a stub backend that cites an id outside its candidate set, so a CLI test can show that a hallucination alone turns the gate red
Make the politeness lock portable: fcntl.flock with a bounded wait where msvcrt is not available
